### Parameter tuning

:::: {.columns .bullet-row .smaller}
::: {.column width="33%"}
- A win needs the full instance set, not three.
- Median + IQR; cactus / performance / split under timeouts.
- Match the metric and plot to the goal.
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
- The Solutions and bounds blocks show the real work.
- Strategy ranks point at what to tune.
- A tuning hypothesis, for free.
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
- Random search is the baseline.
- Model-based search (TPE) spends budget where it pays.
- Prune relentlessly; run it in Optuna.
:::
